rules.rule: S22 is OPTIONS SELL/STOCKS/MONTHLY/DIFF 2D-4D with unique code STOCKS_OP_SELL_MT_DIFF_2D_4D.
One S22 strategy definition applies to stock underlyings; symbol is an instance input.
rules.source: AB2!D27:E27; AB10!E12 as example instance input

rules.rule: S22 consumes independent Monthly Status per enabled stock and maps BULL/BULL_CF/BEAR/BEAR_CF to S22 branches.
Search monthly Near first and only configured expiries; branch-specific Start/End/Last Choice strike, directional traversal, ideal/minimum premium and minimum OI are evaluated per stock.
At ORPT check 09:24:59 AM LL < option sell entry for Call and Put. If not missed place at ORPT; if missed wait for RC 09:29:59 and recalculate branch-specific strike/premium/entry.
One target per one-lot Option Selling position; Target = entry - 60%; Original SL/MSL is Min(entry + 60%, branch-specific option historical high reference plus 7% or 10%).
Carried/open-position SL checks use 09:15 HH > SL; if missed wait until RC and use branch-specific revised FSL/TRP. At 15:00 Close > Original SL exits; Close <= Original SL carries.

Configured order quantity is one lot. RELIANCE workbook example lot size is 250. Exchange units = quantity_lots * lot_size. P&L uses confirmed exchange units and short-option premium difference; no double lot-size multiplication.
rules.source: AB11!H12/K12; AB16!K89/K96; AB16!I90/I97; AB16!W91; global APS clarification

rules.rule: S22 requires STRATEGY_SUPPORTED_UNIVERSE from workbook evidence, EXCHANGE_ELIGIBLE_UNIVERSE from a dated versioned instrument-master snapshot, and an explicit OPERATOR_ENABLED_SUBSET. Current runnable scope is pending user selection of the first enabled stock.

strategy_identity.target_count: 1 target; APS label present but global one-lot Option Selling APS clarification makes APS not applicable
